what: The watermill's files put on the games' UAT host, 26 November 2026 UTC, after the founder answered "Yes, upload to UAT"

notYet: The game on UAT does not ask for these files: the release live there (20261125-484ead40122) was built before the build looked for models.
The host there names a .gltf file application/octet-stream: its Worker is the one deployed with that release, from before the type was added. The loader does not depend on it.
Production has neither the music nor the models.
